8f516d910db7891c.description: About the Role Jobskey Search and Selection is seeking an experienced Technical Sales Engineer specializing in Industrial Solutions on behalf of an esteemed client in the industrial and engineering solutions sector. This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, covering cities such as Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires a commercially driven engineering professional with a strong technical background and a proven track record in business development and key account management. Role Overview The Technical Sales Engineer will be responsible for driving technical sales solutions within the Saudi market. This involves identifying new business opportunities, expanding the client portfolio, and managing relationships with customers and partners. The successful candidate will leverage in-depth product knowledge to provide technical recommendations and manage the sales process from inquiry to deal closure and payment collection. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities across the Saudi market. Proactively approach potential customers to expand the company's client portfolio. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and business partners. Understand technical requirements, prepare RFQs and commercial quotations, and drive negotiations through to deal closure. Develop in-depth knowledge of technical products and solutions to provide appropriate customer recommendations. Negotiate pricing and commercial terms while maintaining targeted profit margins. Monitor sales pipelines, customer activities, forecasts, and business performance through CRM systems. Follow up on customer payments and ensure timely collection. Represent the company at industry exhibitions, conferences, and business events. Candidate Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical sales role. Background in industrial equipment, engineering products, technical solutions, or industrial trading is highly preferred. Proven track record in B2B technical sales and new business development. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Self-driven professional with a strong customer-oriented approach. Strong track record in technical B2B sales, preferably serving manufacturing companies within the Food & Beverage, Pharmaceutical, or Cosmetics industries. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in the Makkah region, with responsibilities covering cities such as Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves active engagement with clients and partners across the Saudi market. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

This full-time role is responsible for supporting various brand initiatives, including activations, product launches, and retail listings, while ensuring strong in-store visibility. The Brand Associate will also monitor market performance and competitor activities to identify opportunities. Key Responsibilities Coordinate brand marketing calendars and activation plans with LÓreal. Support new product launches, including ensuring launch readiness, preparing necessary materials, and following up on execution. Manage new product listings across various retailers (ICF). Coordinate and implement price increases across all retailers. Monitor brand performance, product mix, and category trends. Track competitor activities, market positioning, and promotional initiatives. Coordinate visibility, merchandising, and in-store activation requirements. Monitor assortment performance and identify opportunities for SKU optimization. Track marketing investment utilization and activation effectiveness. The Group offers various career paths, including internal mobility options. 8f582b056921a23d.job_title: QA QC Site Inspector (ELV) Construction Supervision Consultant
8f582b056921a23d.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Site ELV Inspector to join their team. This full-time role involves inspecting, monitoring, and overseeing the installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems on construction projects. The inspector will ensure all ELV works comply with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, applicable standards, and health and safety regulations. Role Context and Collaboration The successful candidate will work closely with contractors, consultants, project teams, and various stakeholders. The primary objective is to ensure the high-quality delivery of ELV systems throughout the project lifecycle. This includes security systems, ICT networks, structured cabling, CCTV, access control, public address systems, building management systems, fire alarm interfaces, and other low-current systems. Key Responsibilities Inspect ELV installation works to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, and applicable standards. Monitor contractor activities to ensure installation quality meets project expectations. Review material deliveries and verify compliance with approved material submittals. Conduct site inspections and prepare inspection reports, observations, and non-conformance reports as necessary. Ensure ELV installations are completed in accordance with quality management procedures and project specifications. Project Monitoring and Coordination Monitor day-to-day ELV construction activities, including structured cabling, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, public address systems, audiovisual systems, ICT infrastructure, BMS integration, and associated interfaces. Verify contractor progress against approved schedules and project milestones. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, including architectural, civil, structural, and MEP disciplines, to resolve site issues. Review method statements, inspection test plans, and work procedures. Identify construction issues and provide recommendations to ensure timely project delivery. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 8 years of experience in a relevant field. This role requires a strong understanding of ELV systems and construction project environments. Application Process This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8ff7175e3682715a.description: About the Role Petromin Corporation is seeking a Service Advisor to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting customers with their vehicle service needs, ensuring exceptional customer service, and maintaining compliance with automotive regulations and company policies. The Service Advisor will enhance the customer experience by clearly explaining vehicle issues and recommending appropriate service options. Key Responsibilities Develop an in-depth understanding of major vehicle systems, including engines, transmissions, electronics, and hybrid technologies specific to models in the Saudi market. Stay updated on the latest advancements in Nissan vehicle features and technologies, focusing on new model releases and updates relevant to Saudi Arabia. Utilize diagnostic tools for preliminary vehicle checks to identify potential issues, streamlining the diagnostic process for technicians. Interpret diagnostic test outcomes to provide accurate communication and preliminary advice to customers regarding service needs. Address minor technical issues on-site to improve turnaround time and customer satisfaction. Translate complex vehicle issues into understandable language for customers, advising on appropriate services or upgrades. Maintain a professional and knowledgeable demeanor while updating customers on vehicle repair status. Assist customers with ordering and locating vehicle parts. Collaborate with the management team to schedule technicians and enhance their safety, efficiency, and productivity. Handle parts orders and manage stock of essential items like tires, optimizing shop operations. Warranty Claims Management Understand Nissan's warranty policies, particularly as they apply within the Saudi market, to clearly explain coverage to customers. Manage all service-related paperwork efficiently, ensuring accuracy in service orders, warranty claims, and compliance with Saudi regulatory standards. Maintain comprehensive records of customer interactions, service histories, and warranty claims for continuity and accountability. Scrutinize service claim details to verify eligibility under warranty, ensuring alignment with Nissan’s guidelines and customer agreements. Regulatory Compliance Ensure all service operations conform to Saudi Arabian regulatory standards, especially those related to vehicle safety and emissions. Provide customers with detailed information on how regional regulations impact their service options, particularly regarding vehicle modifications and emissions standards. Stay informed about changes in automotive regulations and standards, integrating new requirements into service protocols promptly. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant role. Demonstrated understanding of car dealership and maintenance operations. Ability to explain complex vehicle issues in simple terms. Strong customer service skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring strict compliance with Nissan’s high standards, automotive regulations, and company policies and procedures.

8f59e8a7de7ce349.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is a CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) company with over 400 employees, recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The company focuses on business communication solutions, serving over 5000 customer-centric companies. The Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions, working with other departments to meet customer needs. The Role: Product Manager - Data & Insights Unifonic is seeking a Product Manager - Data & Insights to lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role involves managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities, from customer research and data modeling to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. The Product Manager will collaborate with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem and champion data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs, prioritizing initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Advise other Product teams on data strategy and design. Collect business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, Engineering). Develop detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partner with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in data warehouses (*, Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and its impact on performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around ETL/ELT processes and dimensional modeling. Own and enforce data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Define processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Advocate for data accuracy and monitor for misleading or incomplete insights. Own the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (*, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Define self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams and create feedback loops to improve dashboard usability and relevance. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines. Qualifications and Requirements Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL. Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders. Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas. Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is a plus. Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations when building reporting solutions. Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights. Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively. AI Proficiency and Character Traits Candidates should demonstrate a minimum of L4 (Proficient) AI proficiency, applying AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. This includes using AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, while personally owning the accuracy of every output. Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable is required, along with the ability to write structured prompts and refine them. The role also requires synthesizing interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, validating every insight against source data. Character traits include analytical thinking, problem-solving, ownership, accountability, strong communication, collaboration, adaptability, continuous learning, mentorship, knowledge sharing, resilience, quality, attention to detail, advocacy, and innovation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Unifonic fosters a collaborative work environment that encourages creativity and new ideas.

8fe4e97f2d3bd862.description: About KBR KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. The organization fosters a diverse workforce, attracting professionals who contribute to its expertise through creativity and resourcefulness. The Role of Quantity Surveyor Insulation KBR is seeking a Quantity Surveyor Insulation to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time position involves key responsibilities within contracts management and procurement, focusing on cost estimation, control, and final account preparation for insulation projects. Key Responsibilities Prepare preliminary cost estimates based on project drawings, specifications, and requirements. Measure quantities and compile detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for accurate estimations. Monitor ongoing project costs to ensure adherence to the allocated budget. Reconcile all project costs upon completion for final settlement and account preparation. Assess contractor claims and certify interim payments based on project valuations and progress. Experience and Work Type Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering locations such as Rabigh and Makkah. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the hiring process.

8f15bbb5dcb3f5a5.description: About Hatch Hatch is a company with over 70 years of business and technical expertise in the mining, energy, and infrastructure sectors. With 10,000 colleagues operating in 150 countries, the company focuses on providing practical, safe, innovative, and sustainable solutions globally while acting locally. The Role of Frontend Developer & Designer Hatch is seeking a Frontend Developer & Designer to join the Product Development team within its Digital Practice in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is suitable for a creative individual with 5-10 years of experience who aims to deliver digital products in an evolving industry. The position focuses on identifying, designing, building, and productizing Hatch's subject matter expertise within the Digital Products group. The successful candidate will work alongside existing senior designers and a product manager to support and accelerate an established product team. Key Responsibilities Execute end-to-end product design work, including interaction design, visual design, prototyping, design QA, and handoff, in collaboration with senior designers. Extend existing design work, understanding the intent and constraints behind established patterns, and translating this into new, consistent design. Partner with senior designers and the product manager to produce design artifacts at the required cadence and fidelity for an AI-augmented development team. Utilize AI-assisted design and prototyping tools as a core part of the daily workflow to reduce the time from idea to clickable artifact and merged UI. Contribute UI directly to the React (TypeScript) codebase as front-end development capabilities grow, starting with component-level work and design-system contributions. Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the product design system, making established patterns explicit for consumption by developers and AI tooling. Collaborate with product management to refine acceptance criteria, validate user needs, and ensure design intent is maintained in the shipped product. Emphasize collaboration and communication within and outside the team to improve product delivery processes. Communicate open items, trade-offs, and risks to senior designers, product management, and leadership. Stay informed about developments in design tooling, AI-assisted design, and front-end UI practices. Work effectively in a team environment with shared design files and code, maintaining disciplined use of version control, design-file hygiene, and process documentation. Candidate Profile and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Deep UX foundations and demonstrated fluency in AI-assisted design workflows. A clear and active trajectory into front-end development. Exceptional communication skills and a strong design point of view. Ability to interpret and extend the work of other designers. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers a flexible work environment within a top employer. Hatch provides opportunities for long-term career development and the chance to collaborate on projects that develop innovative solutions. The company encourages a global perspective while maintaining a local presence.

8f193230f27feda5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة البابطين للطاقه والاتصالات عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المعماري مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة، الإضافات، أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. يشمل الدور أيضاً المساعدة في اختيار المواقع والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها. مهارات قوية في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. نوع العمل والموقع هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

8f512200b52e4025.description: About Noon Academy Noon Academy is an EdTech platform focused on transforming education. The company aims to make learning social, engaging, and technology-driven. As a leading platform in the Middle East, Noon Academy serves over 12 million students and teachers. The company is currently focused on reinventing schools in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, by integrating social, group-based learning, and AI to enhance the classroom experience and improve learning efficacy. About the Role Noon Academy is seeking a Head of Teaching Excellence & Operations to manage the entire teacher lifecycle across its Masarat and Ufuq programs. This full-time role involves overseeing workforce planning, hiring, development, deployment, performance management, and career progression for teachers. The Head of Teaching Excellence & Operations will establish systems, processes, and leadership practices to scale a high-performing teaching workforce while maintaining instructional quality. The position requires a blend of educational judgment and operational discipline to ensure effective teacher placement and support. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain a teacher demand model by subject, grade, and site, translating delivery requirements into hiring and capacity plans. Manage the end-to-end recruitment pipeline, including sourcing, screening, teaching demonstrations, selection, and readiness for deployment. Establish consistent selection rubrics to assess subject expertise, instructional practice, and suitability for the delivery model. Monitor recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, and hiring quality to identify bottlenecks and ensure reliable staffing. Design and implement structured onboarding programs for teachers to prepare them for effective classroom delivery. Build continuing professional development (CPD) programs linked to observed teaching practice and student learning outcomes. Establish a tiered career pathway for teachers with clear expectations, progression criteria, and development opportunities. Equip teacher leaders and managers to provide effective coaching and follow through on development plans. Oversee teacher assignment and scheduling across Masarat and Ufuq, aligning expertise with classroom needs. Balance teaching load, development time, and wider contributions without compromising instructional quality. Maintain visibility of workforce capacity, utilization, and coverage risks, developing contingency plans for staffing gaps. Coordinate with academic and delivery teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and support teaching continuity. Establish a consistent observation cadence across all classrooms, supported by clear quality standards and calibrated judgments. Combine observation evidence with student feedback, learning outcomes, and platform data to identify strengths and improvement priorities. Implement timely feedback loops and structured improvement plans with clear expectations, support, and review points. Manage intervention and exit protocols, addressing sustained underperformance fairly and consistently in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Identify, recognize, and retain high-performing teachers. Create structured opportunities for teachers to contribute beyond classroom delivery, including content development, assessment item writing, peer coaching, and quality review. Match opportunities to demonstrated expertise, interests, and organizational needs. Define clear time allocations, deliverables, quality expectations, and recognition for these contributions. Track participation, output quality, and impact to ensure capability activation is measurable and sustainable. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in education leadership or operations. Demonstrated ability to build and scale high-performing teaching workforces. Experience in instructional quality assurance and teacher development. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

8fca5461b444e719.description: About OilSERV OilSERV is an oilfield services company operating within the Oil & Gas industry. The company is committed to operational excellence, compliance, safety, and delivering high-quality services to its clients. The Role of Human Resources Specialist OilSERV is seeking a Human Resources Specialist to support operations in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring effective coordination with government authorities, managing employee residency and visa processes, and maintaining compliance with applicable regulations. The specialist will manage employee residency, immigration, and government-related administrative processes, coordinating with government entities, managing visa and Iqama applications, and supporting Saudi Aramco identification requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage employee residency applications, renewals, and related documentation for non-Saudi employees. Coordinate work visas, business visit visas, and other immigration-related applications. Maintain accurate records of employee residency status, visa applications, and government-related documentation. Manage Saudi Aramco portal activities, including employee ID and Sticker applications, scheduling, and processing. Attend appointments with Saudi Aramco and government authorities as required. Liaise with the Ministry of Interior (MOI), Ministry of Finance (MOF), and other relevant government entities. Monitor residency and visa application progress, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution of outstanding matters. Support compliance with applicable Saudi regulations and company policies. Provide regular updates to the HR team regarding residency and government-related matters. Maintain professional relationships with government authorities, clients, and logistics and clearance service providers. Support the resolution of administrative and documentation-related issues with relevant authorities. Perform HR administrative duties and maintain organized records and correspondence. Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical standards, and applicable HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience Relevant experience of 2-5 years in Government Relations, HR Administration, or a similar function in Saudi Arabia. Practical experience managing Iqama applications, residency renewals, and visa processing. Familiarity with Saudi government procedures and regulatory requirements. Experience coordinating directly with government authorities and processing official documentation. Previous experience managing Saudi Aramco ID/Sticker applications is highly desirable. Required Skills Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple administrative processes, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accurate records. Willingness to attend government offices and Saudi Aramco facilities across Saudi Arabia when required. Compensation A competitive compensation package will be offered in accordance with company policies and the candidate's qualifications and experience.

8fe63d1d53fd3ebf.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع اليمامه لانتاج ابراج الطاقه الكهربائية عن مصمم جرافيك للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تطوير الأفكار والمفاهيم الإبداعية لتوصيل الرسائل المطلوبة عبر وسائل الجرافيك، وتصميم الإنتاج لمختلف الوسائط المنشورة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية التنسيق مع أصحاب التصميم (العملاء الداخليين أو الخارجيين) لفهم الرسالة المطلوبة، وتحديد المتطلبات، والاتفاق على المنتج النهائي. تطوير مفاهيم تصميم عامة تلبي احتياجات العميل، وصياغة أسلوب يتناسب مع الصورة والوضع المرغوبين. تقديم المشورة الفنية المتعلقة بمفاهيم التصميم العامة، وتقديم الإرشادات حول المتطلبات الأسلوبية مثل الألوان والصور ونمط النص والتخطيط، لضمان توصيل الرسالة بفعالية. تسليم المنتج النهائي للعميل، وجمع الملاحظات، وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تصميم الجرافيك. القدرة على تطوير أفكار ومفاهيم إبداعية. مهارات قوية في تصميم الإنتاج لمختلف الوسائط. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل. الموقع يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

8f2526df1a686e6f.description: About the Company and Role CAMAC Talent is partnering with a global software company specializing in the energy sector. This company provides a platform used by energy businesses worldwide, from emerging operators to major industry players, to manage operations and enhance data-driven decision-making. As the business expands in the Middle East, it is seeking a Country Lead / Senior Strategic Account Manager to be based in Dhahran, Eastern Province. This is a full-time position. Role Overview This senior, high-impact role serves as the company's lead in the Saudi market. The Senior Strategic Account Manager will be responsible for managing strategic accounts end-to-end, covering both pre-sale and post-sale phases, and for expanding the business's presence within these accounts. The focus of this position is on executive relationships, account strategy, and deal closure, with technical depth handled by solutions architects and consultants. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute detailed account plans for a portfolio of strategic energy accounts. Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and key stakeholders. Formulate account strategies to increase market share across the full product and services suite. Lead client relationships at the company level and position against competitors. Collaborate with solutions, services, product, and marketing teams to develop client messaging. Identify new opportunities and close complex, high-value deals. Deliver business, technical, and financial briefings to senior leadership. Achieve short-term and long-term revenue targets. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in enterprise software sales or strategic account management. Demonstrated track record of selling into the oil and gas sector in Saudi Arabia; experience in upstream is an advantage. A strong professional network across major energy organizations within the Kingdom. Experience in presenting to and influencing C-level executives. Strong negotiation, proposal development, and deal-closing skills. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 8fc9f9e0fb3d7228.description: About the Role Seara International is seeking a Custom Clearance Section Head to manage import and export clearance operations. Role Overview The Custom Clearance Section Head will oversee all aspects of import and export clearance for raw materials, packaging, equipment, and finished goods within a frozen food manufacturing environment. The primary objective is to ensure strict adherence to SFDA and customs regulations, prevent shipment holds, avoid cold-chain integrity loss, and minimize demurrage and detention fees. Key Responsibilities Supervise and prepare all import/export shipping documentation, including Bills of Lading, Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, Halal Certificates, and Health/Phytosanitary Certificates. Submit, monitor, and track customs declarations via government and customs portals (*, FASAH, SABER, Bayan, or regional equivalents). Facilitate physical inspections, port sampling, and laboratory testing protocols for perishable and temperature-sensitive goods. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of national trade laws, food import restrictions, labelling standards, and shelf-life requirements. Prioritize release for reefer (refrigerated) containers to preserve cold-chain continuity and prevent product spoilage. Monitor reefer container plugged-in statuses and plug-in charges at ports and clearance zones. Proactively resolve holds, documentation discrepancies, and inspection delays to mitigate demurrage, storage, and detention penalties. Demonstrated knowledge of SFDA and customs regulations. Experience with government and customs portals (*, FASAH, SABER, Bayan). Strong understanding of cold-chain standards and perishable goods handling. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with operational responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic frozen food manufacturing environment, requiring close coordination with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure efficient and compliant clearance processes.

8f5eac4c0e6c2166.description: About the Role Norconsult Telematics is seeking a Senior Odoo Code and Performance Optimization Expert to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on enhancing the performance, scalability, and reliability of the company’s Odoo platform. The expert will identify and resolve bottlenecks across application code, PostgreSQL databases, and supporting infrastructure, aiming for measurable improvements in response times and concurrent-user capacity. Key Objectives The primary objective of this position is to deliver significant performance enhancements while maintaining functionality, security, and data integrity. The role also involves strengthening the development team’s performance optimization practices through documentation and coaching. Initial goals include establishing performance baselines and implementing priority improvements within the first 90 days. Responsibilities Establish performance baselines for critical user journeys and define measurable response-time targets with stakeholders. Profile Odoo, Python, PostgreSQL, and infrastructure components to diagnose latency, lock contention, memory issues, and repeated processing. Develop and maintain a prioritized optimization backlog based on business impact and technical findings. Refactor custom Odoo modules and Python code to optimize database queries, computations, batching, and caching. Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexes, execution plans, and transaction handling while ensuring data integrity and security. Review and tune Linux/RHEL, Nginx, and Docker configurations to address resource constraints and bottlenecks. Conduct performance and load testing in preproduction environments to validate response times and peak-load capacity. Deliver changes via peer-reviewed pull requests, automated regression testing, and controlled releases with post-release verification. Document findings, implemented changes, and measured outcomes, and provide coaching to developers on performance optimization. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 7 years in software engineering, with at least 5 years of hands-on Odoo development and a proven track record in optimizing production environments. Experience with recent Odoo versions; Odoo 18 experience is preferred. Advanced Python development skills, including debugging, algorithm optimization, and memory analysis. In-depth knowledge of the Odoo ORM, including inheritance, domains, computed/stored fields, dependency tracking, caching, scheduled jobs, access rights, and record rules. Advanced PostgreSQL skills, including SQL, execution-plan analysis (EXPLAIN ANALYZE with BUFFERS), indexing, query statistics, transactions, locking, deadlocks, and connection management. Strong understanding of PostgreSQL planner statistics and autovacuum, with the ability to trace database bottlenecks to application code. Hands-on experience with Odoo SQL and Periodic profiling, Python profiling (cProfile or equivalent), and memory profiling. Ability to interpret call stacks and flame graphs, correlating findings with PostgreSQL statistics (pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_activity, pg_locks) and ELK logs. Strong Linux/RHEL administration and Nginx configuration skills, covering CPU, memory, I/O diagnostics, reverse proxies, load balancing, TLS, and connection management. Hands-on Docker experience including Dockerfiles, image builds, Compose, networking, volumes, health checks, logs, and resource limits, with troubleshooting expertise for CPU throttling and out-of-memory events. Experience with API integrations, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and load-testing tools such as Locust, JMeter, or k6. Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to implement production fixes and transfer knowledge. Ability to present two production performance optimization case studies detailing the problem, personal contribution, and measurable before-and-after results. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in software engineering and Odoo development, with a focus on performance optimization in production environments. Application Process Norconsult Telematics invites qualified candidates to apply for this Senior Odoo Code and Performance Optimization Expert position in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

8fb5a6440da7e9ac.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة يبحث فندق شذا البحر للايواء السياحي عن نادل للانضمام إلى فريقه في ضبا، تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم خدمة ضيافة ممتازة للضيوف، مع ضمان تجربة تناول طعام ممتعة وفعالة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الضيافة. الهدف من الدور يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم خدمات الضيافة للضيوف بكفاءة واحترافية، بما في ذلك استقبال الطلبات وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات وفقًا لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة. كما يشمل الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المطعم ومناطق الخدمة، والتأكد من جاهزية الطاولات والأدوات قبل وأثناء وبعد الخدمة لضمان رضا الضيوف. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الضيوف والترحيب بهم وتقديم خدمة احترافية. أخذ طلبات العملاء وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات وفق المعايير المعتمدة. إعداد وترتيب الطاولات ومناطق الخدمة قبل بدء العمل. تنظيف الطاولات والكراسي ومعدات الخدمة والمحافظة على نظافة المطعم بشكل مستمر. الالتزام بإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والنظافة الشخصية وسلامة الأغذية. التعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان تقديم خدمة متميزة وتحقيق رضا الضيوف. الإبلاغ عن أي ملاحظات أو احتياجات تتعلق بالنظافة أو الصيانة. تنفيذ المهام الأخرى ذات الصلة بطبيعة العمل وفق توجيهات المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الضيافة أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على تقديم خدمة احترافية وممتازة للضيوف. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والنظافة. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل النادل ضمن فريق الضيافة في فندق شذا البحر للايواء السياحي بمدينة ضبا، تبوك. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع الضيوف والتعاون مع الزملاء لضمان تقديم أفضل مستوى من الخدمة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في قطاع الضيافة بمدينة ضبا. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

Qualifications & Experience Education · Tertiary qualification in Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline. · Professional certifications in project or development management (e.g., PMP, RICS, PRINCE2) is preferred. Work Experience · 7–10 years’ experience in project management roles delivering commercial office, mixed-use, or large-scale developments. · Demonstrated experience managing projects through design, procurement, construction, and handover. · Experience working within large, complex development or infrastructure programs is highly regarded. · Experience working in environments with strong governance and reporting requirements. · Experience and exposure to large-scale integrated development programs highly regarded. · Knowledge of ESG and sustainability frameworks (LEED, Green Star, BREEAM, etc.) required. · Knowledge of Smart Building Technologies in relation to Office Buildings will be advantageous. 8f07697b18bb6944.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن فني دعم تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني للموظفين وضمان كفاءة تشغيل أجهزة الحاسب والبرامج والشبكات ومعدات تقنية المعلومات. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة معالجة الطلبات والأعطال وإدارة الأصول وفقًا لسياسات الأمن والصلاحيات المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للمستخدمين فيما يتعلق بالأجهزة والبرامج والطابعات والبريد الإلكتروني. تشخيص وحل مشكلات الحاسب والشبكات والأنظمة المختلفة. تركيب وتهيئة وصيانة الحواسيب والطابعات والبرامج. إدارة حسابات المستخدمين وإعادة تعيين كلمات المرور والصلاحيات وفقًا للإجراءات المحددة. متابعة الأعطال والانقطاعات وتصعيدها إلى الجهات المختصة عند الضرورة. تحديث سجلات الأصول وطلبات الدعم والإصلاح والتسليم. دعم تحديثات البرامج وتطبيقات الحماية والتصحيحات الأمنية. تدريب المستخدمين على التطبيقات والأدوات المعتمدة. التنسيق مع الموردين والالتزام بسياسات أمن المعلومات وسريتها. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال دعم تقنية المعلومات أو مجال ذي صلة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادرًا على التعامل مع المهام المذكورة بكفاءة وفعالية. نوع العمل الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في رابغ، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الكشف عنه في الوقت الحالي.

8fae459fe1ea07b9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نظم البيئة للمقاولات عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، الجبيل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد المخاطر، وتوفير أدوات السلامة اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل هذه الوظيفة إلى ضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية من خلال إعداد وتطوير الأسس والقواعد والإجراءات الخاصة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. يشمل ذلك تحديد الأخطار المهنية المحتملة في مواقع العمل ووضع الإجراءات الوقائية لتفاديها، ومتابعة توفير مستلزمات السلامة واستخدامها الفعال من قبل العاملين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، مثل سياسات السلامة، تعليمات العمل الآمن، خطط الإخلاء، تعليمات لجان السلامة، وسجلات السلامة والفحص الطبي. متابعة اعتماد هذه الإجراءات والتعليمات ومراقبة مدى التزام العاملين بها. تحديد مكامن الأخطار الميكانيكية والكهربائية والكيميائية في مواقع العمل ووضع الإشارات والملصقات التحذيرية المناسبة. إعداد قوائم ببنود وكميات ومواصفات معدات ومستلزمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، ومتابعة توفيرها وضمان التزام العاملين باستخدامها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. معرفة قوية بأسس وقواعد وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر المهنية ووضع حلول وقائية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مواقع الشركة بالجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية العالية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

8f049f8f8fa6eeae.description: About Sirar by stc Sirar by stc, established by stc, is an advanced technology and cybersecurity company. 8f402d67ebff0dcd.description: About Pasqal Pasqal specializes in the design and development of Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) and their associated software tools. The company's technology aims to address complex use cases beyond the current capabilities of supercomputers, encompassing both industrial applications and fundamental scientific research. Pasqal's QPUs are designed for high energy efficiency, contributing to a reduction in the carbon footprint of the High-Performance Computing (HPC) industry. The Role: Senior Quantum Solutions Engineer ML Pasqal is seeking a Senior Quantum Solutions Engineer ML to join the Quantum Applications department's delivery team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Thuwal or Makkah, and focuses on building and delivering client-facing solutions utilizing Pasqal’s quantum ML algorithm portfolio. The role is application-driven, involving the adaptation, integration, and deployment of existing approaches to address real-world partner and client use cases. The primary objective is to transform current methods into reliable client deliverables, with contributions to internal method improvement welcomed when they directly support project outcomes. Key Responsibilities Adapt and implement Pasqal’s existing quantum-enhanced graph ML algorithms to meet client datasets, constraints, and performance targets. Build and maintain robust ML pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, training, evaluation, and post-processing, with integration into quantum execution workflows, emulation/simulation platforms, and internal tooling. Establish baselines, metrics, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders, driving solution iterations until delivery requirements are met. Collaborate with internal R&D teams to transfer methods from research to application, clarify assumptions/limits, and select optimal approaches from the portfolio for each use case. Work with hardware and platform engineers to execute solutions on Pasqal QPUs, considering hardware and execution constraints, and reliability. Engage with domain experts from high-profile enterprises and partners to deliver solutions for real-world business problems. Produce maintainable code, documentation, and handover materials to ensure delivered solutions can be reused and supported. Maintain regular scientific and technological awareness. Qualifications and Experience Approximately 5 to 10 years of professional experience as a machine learning engineer. Demonstrated interest in quantum computing. A background in physics is considered a plus, but is not a mandatory requirement. Recruitment Process An initial 30-minute interview with the talent acquisition team. A 60-minute meeting with the team, including a technical test. An exchange with the Shaheen Engineering Manager. A final interview with Louis-Paul, the VP. An offer. Commitment to Diversity Pasqal is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. The company encourages applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of gender, ethnicity, age, religion, or sexual orientation. Joining Pasqal offers the opportunity to contribute to the rapid development of a DeepTech scale-up at the forefront of quantum technology, working alongside scientists and engineers on significant technological challenges.

8f49e12e79e614ed.description: About Soum Soum is a B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and cars across Saudi Arabia via its website and mobile app. The platform focuses on building trust for both buyers and sellers. With the recent introduction of a subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum aims to be a recommerce platform in the Kingdom. The Role of Consumer Product Manager The Consumer Product Manager is responsible for the customer experience, covering how buyers discover, evaluate, purchase, and receive used items, and how sellers list, price, and get paid. This role involves representing the Soum customer within the product team, translating consumer insights into features that enhance conversion, repeat purchases, and trust. The manager will work across app and web platforms, collaborating with design, engineering, operations, and commercial teams to implement and iterate on product features. Key Responsibilities Manage the roadmap for a core consumer area, such as the buyer journey, seller journey, or subscriptions, prioritizing based on impact on conversion, retention, GMV, and customer trust. Develop a continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets, and behavioral data. Optimize the end-to-end marketplace funnel, including listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns, and post-purchase experience. Design and improve trust features such as device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings, and transparent pricing. Shape subscription products for electronics and cars, focusing on value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement, and retention, in collaboration with Commercial and Finance teams. Translate problems into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria, and manage agile delivery with design and engineering teams. Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localization for Saudi customers. Implement a disciplined experimentation practice, including forming hypotheses, designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and making evidence-based decisions. Monitor and report on core consumer KPIs, including conversion rate, listing-to-sale rate, activation, repeat purchase, subscription retention, NPS, and customer complaints. Partner with Operations (inspection, logistics, customer service), Marketing and Growth (acquisition, CRM), and Finance to ensure product changes are effective end-to-end. Monitor regional and global marketplaces and recommerce players to identify and adapt best practices for Soum's customers. Qualifications and Requirements 2–4 years of product management experience with consumer-facing digital products such as marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech, or consumer apps. Proven track record of delivering consumer features that have demonstrably impacted business metrics. Strong consumer intuition supported by data, with proficiency in product analytics tools (*, Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), funnel analysis, and A/B testing; working knowledge of SQL is an advantage. Hands-on experience developing for mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. Solid understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, including supply and demand balance, liquidity, trust, and pricing. Experience collaborating with designers and engineers in an agile environment, with clear written specifications and prioritization skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, capable of aligning operations, commercial, and technical teams. A proactive approach, demonstrating the ability to make decisions with incomplete information and prioritize outcomes over output. Preferred Qualifications Experience with KSA or GCC consumers, Arabic/RTL products, and local payment methods. Background in used goods, recommerce, automotive, or subscription businesses. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

8f56b5e3e9501df6.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company (شركة قدية الاستثمارية) is seeking a Senior Director - Commercial to lead the commercial strategy, governance, and performance for major development, construction, infrastructure, or real estate programs. Oversee commercial governance, cost management, procurement strategy, contract administration, and financial controls. 8fe08808d07cc9c0.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات عن مشغل محطة تحلية مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة أنظمة وآلات التحكم لضمان كفاءة إنتاج المياه المحلاة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل أنظمة التحكم بتحلية المياه، والعمل على إزالة الأملاح والمعادن لإنتاج المياه العذبة. مراقبة عمليات وأنظمة التحكم، وضمان بقاء جودة وحجم إمدادات المياه ضمن الحدود المحددة مسبقاً، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية عند الضرورة. القيام بعمليات فحص روتينية خاصة بأعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الأساسية للأجزاء المعطلة أو المتضررة، وإعداد تقارير بالأعطال لفنيي أو تقنيي الصيانة، واختبار المعدات بعد إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تشغيل محطات تحلية المياه أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لأنظمة التحكم في تحلية المياه وعملياتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الأساسية وتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل تتطلب هذه الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في محطة تحلية المياه بالجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل المشغل ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمليات المحطة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

8fa5eb50078f5995.description: MEP Manager Dammam, Saudi Arabia Accommodation, car, insurance, visa and flight costs covered by client Role overview: Overall Responsibility for all site MEP technical and engineering aspects of their assigned project in conjunction with subordinate discipline Project Engineers and BIM / Design Team leads. Management of red-line drawings and As-built drawings in coordination with BIM Lead, Construction teams and QA/QC teams. Management of the MEP systems O&Ms to Code A status Management and coordination with Commissioning team for client training requirements. Ensuring that the HSE requirements are observed in the execution of all engineering activities. Provide regular input to the continuous improvement log (lessons learned), implementing changes where deficiencies are identified and corrective actions proposed. Ensure awareness and compliance of the QSP’s which are located and maintained in the JEG Group Quality Library. Provides a working environment that develops a highly productive, adaptive, motivated and creative team which builds cooperation, respect, Team and Self focus, openness, respect and commitment

8f764db58d487c78.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مركز الفداء المتميز للرعاية النهارية عن أخصائي أمراض نطق وسمع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض النطق والسمع، وتقديم الدعم اللازم للمرضى وعائلاتهم. يتضمن الدور إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالحالات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مقابلة المرضى وفحصهم ومراجعة تاريخهم الطبي لفهم مشكلات النطق والسمع التي يعانون منها. تشخيص طبيعة الإصابات والأمراض المرتبطة بالنطق والسمع وأسبابها بناءً على الفحوصات ونتائج الاختبارات. تقديم الرعاية المتخصصة لعلاج أمراض النطق والسمع، ووصف التقنيات المناسبة مثل لغة الإشارة للمرضى. إحالة المرضى إلى الأطباء الأخصائيين أو التعليميين الإضافيين إذا لزم الأمر. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بأمراض النطق والسمع وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف عمليات أمراض النطق والسمع. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمراض النطق والسمع. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من اضطرابات النطق والسمع. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة في إعداد وحفظ التقارير. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وعائلاتهم. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في التشخيص وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي أمراض النطق والسمع ضمن بيئة رعاية نهارية في جدة، مكة المكرمة، حيث يتم التركيز على تقديم رعاية متخصصة وشاملة للمرضى. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع الحالات المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. نشجع المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.
